summary: State/action model for mo-execute-and-fulfill. Five coupled state machines: (1) MO lifecycle (status enum 'open'|'done' plus soft-delete cancel via deletedAt), (2) MO batch lifecycle on manufacturing_order_batches (status 'pending'|'in_progress'|'completed' plus lotId stamp), (3) MO ingredient pick state (derived from manufacturing_pick_allocations sum vs ingredient plannedQuantity; pickStatus column reflects fully-picked), (4) sales shipment lifecycle on sales_shipments (status 'planned'|'shipped' with shippedAt), and (5) stock_allocations bucket sub-machine (demandType in {sales_order_line, sales_shipment_line, manufacturing_order_ingredient} + status {active, consumed, cancelled}). Transitions reference the Phase 1 contract citations directly so each guard, observable change, and failure mode is grounded.

inferences: MO_DRAFT is the pre-create state in this feature: 'released' is the entry point for the execute-and-fulfill surface. We model it for completeness but no transitions from MO_DRAFT are owned by this feature (release is owned by the planning/release surface).

MO_WORK_STARTED is derived from observable evidence: either at least one manufacturing_pick_allocation exists for an ingredient OR at least one batch row has status='in_progress'/'completed'. There is no dedicated column for this — it is a virtual state inferred from child rows. We model it so cancellation safety, the picking partial-progress invariant, and the 'no double-effect' invariants are testable.

The MO status enum is binary ('open' | 'done'). 'cancelled' is encoded as deletedAt SET (soft delete). 'released'/'work-started'/'work-in-progress' are all status='open' with different sub-state combinations; partially_shipped is a sales-side concept and does not apply to MO.

INGREDIENT_PARTIAL is observable only when an ingredient is partially picked via an alternate-material path AND not yet fully picked. In practice pickManufacturingIngredient picks the FULL remaining planned quantity for an ingredient in one call (per evidence 'mark done' button), so partial-pick state is typically transient between the held-branch and FIFO-branch within a single tx. We retain it as a state so the held-vs-FIFO sequencing inside a single pick can be analysed.

BATCH_PICKED is a sub-state of BATCH_STARTED, marked by manufacturingOrderBatches.pickedAt being non-null. It is not a distinct status enum value but it is observable. We model it because BR-12 implies the order of pick-then-complete inside a batch.

The 'Cancel MO that has consumption events' blocked transition is enforced by the unpick path inside cancelReleasedManufacturingOrderInTx: if pick allocations have been consumed into outputs, those outputs would already have created lots and the cancel cannot cleanly reverse without an explicit output reversal first. We mark this blocked transition as confidence medium because the exact code surface was not fully opened in Phase 1.

BUCKET_MO_SOURCE (sourceType='manufacturing_order') is a sub-state of an allocation, not a demand bucket. We model it because moving allocations between buckets and materialising MO promises onto produced lots are distinct transitions in stock_allocations.
SHIPMENT_DRAFT is NOT a separate enum value — the schema CHECK is just ('planned','shipped'). 'draft' shipments in the CLAUDE.md domain notes correspond to status='planned'.
unknowns: Whether a discrete MO that has had /outputs recorded but not /complete can be cancelled. The DAL cancel path attempts to release reservations and cancel allocations, but it is unclear whether it deletes the produced lot. Phase 2 marks this transition blocked with medium confidence.

The exact line-by-line behaviour of reverseManufacturingOutputInTx when the produced lot has already been partially consumed by a sales shipment. The contract notes the produced lot is decremented and ingredient restocks via variance_gain events, but the shipment-already-consumed case may surface a domain error not explicit in the contract.

Whether saveManufacturingOutputAllocation can transition an allocation from BUCKET_MO_INGREDIENT to BUCKET_SO_LINE within a single PUT, or whether that movement is owned by separate sales-side allocation helpers.

machines.name: MO_LIFECYCLE
machines.description: Manufacturing order lifecycle on manufacturing_orders. Binary status enum plus soft-delete cancel.

machines.name: BATCH_LIFECYCLE
machines.description: Per-batch lifecycle on manufacturing_order_batches for manufacturingMode='batch' parents.

machines.name: INGREDIENT_PICK
machines.description: Per-ingredient pick state derived from manufacturing_pick_allocations sum vs planned. Reflected in manufacturing_order_ingredients.pickStatus when fully picked.

machines.name: ALLOCATION_BUCKET
machines.description: Per-row sub-machine on stock_allocations. demandType is the bucket; status closes/cancels the row; sourceType distinguishes inventory_lot holds from MO promises.

states.name: MO_DRAFT
states.description: Pre-create / pre-release. No row in manufacturing_orders yet, OR row exists in a draft state owned by a different surface than this feature.
entry_conditions: Order not yet released; this feature's API surface does not write this state
visible_indicators: No /execute page route entry; order does not appear in execution queue
invariants: No manufacturing_pick_allocations exist
No manufacturing_order_outputs exist
No manufacturing_order_batches in 'in_progress'/'completed'

states.name: MO_RELEASED
states.description: Released MO with no execution work started yet. Demand and expected supply are recorded; no stock consumed; no batches started; no outputs recorded.
entry_conditions: No manufacturing_pick_allocations rows for this MO
No manufacturing_order_outputs rows for this MO
visible_indicators: /execute page shows ingredients list with all rows pickStatus='not_picked'
Status badge 'released'/'open'
Start Batch button visible on the current batch (batch-mode)
invariants: Ingredient demand allocations exist as stock_allocations(demandType='manufacturing_order_ingredient', status='active')
Expected supply contribution from this MO present in inventory_expected_summary (subtype 'manufacturing_release')
No inventory_lot_balances mutated by this MO

states.name: MO_WORK_STARTED
states.description: Virtual sub-state of status='open' indicating execution has begun. At least one pick allocation OR at least one batch in_progress/completed. Cancellation safety depends on whether outputs have been recorded.
entry_conditions: AT LEAST ONE of: manufacturing_pick_allocations row for this MO OR manufacturing_order_batches.status IN ('in_progress','completed') OR manufacturing_order_outputs row
visible_indicators: Pick progress badge shows partial / full
At least one ingredient row in /execute shows pickStatus='picked'
Batch-mode: current batch may be in_progress or completed
invariants: Inventory ledger has at least one event of subtype 'manufacturing_pick' OR 'manufacturing_output'
Some manufacturing_pick_allocations rows exist OR some inventory events of subtype 'manufacturing_output' exist

states.name: MO_COMPLETED
states.description: Terminal closed state. Status flipped to 'done'; output lot(s) produced; expected supply zeroed; reservations released.
entry_conditions: For batch-mode: every manufacturing_order_batches.status = 'completed' and batch.lotId is non-null
visible_indicators: Status badge 'done'
Order does not appear in execution queue
/execute page shows completed banner
invariants: manufacturing_orders.actualMaterialCost and actualCostPerUnit are set
Inventory expected summary released via subtype 'manufacturing_complete' AND releaseRemainingExpectedOutputInTx
stock_allocations(demandType='manufacturing_order_ingredient') for this MO are status='consumed' (or 'cancelled' for unpicked alternates)
Produced output is a lot with non-null unitCost
Idempotency-key replays of /complete return cached envelope without double-effect

states.name: MO_CANCELLED
states.description: Soft-deleted MO via DELETE /[id]. Reservations released, expected supply released, allocations cancelled.
entry_conditions: No surviving manufacturing_order_outputs rows for this MO
visible_indicators: Order does not appear in execution queue or detail
Direct GET returns 404
invariants: Any picked ingredient quantities have been restocked
stock_allocations sourced from this MO OR demanded by this MO's ingredients are status='cancelled'
Expected supply for this MO is zero in inventory_expected_summary

states.name: BATCH_PENDING
states.description: Batch row created on release; not yet started.
visible_indicators: Start Batch button visible for this batch on /execute
invariants: No picks against batch's ingredients yet

states.name: BATCH_STARTED
states.description: Batch in progress: pickable but not yet complete.
visible_indicators: Pick buttons enabled for current batch ingredients
invariants: canPick=true for current batch only

states.name: BATCH_PICKED
states.description: All ingredients for this batch fully picked; pickedAt stamped. Sub-state of BATCH_STARTED — status remains 'in_progress'.
visible_indicators: Complete Batch button enabled
invariants: Every batch ingredient row pickStatus='picked'

states.name: BATCH_COMPLETED
states.description: Batch complete: one new lot produced, lotId stamped, actualQuantity set, completedAt stamped.
visible_indicators: Batch row shows produced lot link
invariants: Exactly one new lots row created by this batch with unitCost non-null
manufacturing_order_outputs row exists referencing the batch
If all sibling batches completed: parent MO transitions to MO_COMPLETED

states.name: INGREDIENT_UNPICKED
states.description: No pick allocations exist for this ingredient.
entry_conditions: No manufacturing_pick_allocations rows for this ingredient
visible_indicators: Ingredient row shows 'Mark done' button enabled (when canPick=true)
invariants: stock_allocations(demandType='manufacturing_order_ingredient', demandId=ingredient.id) all status='active'

states.name: INGREDIENT_PARTIAL
states.description: Some manufacturing_pick_allocations exist but SUM(quantity_used) < ingredient.plannedQuantity. Typically transient inside a single pick tx between held-branch and FIFO-branch.
visible_indicators: Generally not surfaced in /execute since pick takes the full remaining quantity per call
invariants: Reservation remainder still tracked on inventory_reservations_summary for this MO+item

states.name: INGREDIENT_FULL
visible_indicators: Ingredient row shows 'Picked' badge; Mark done disabled
invariants: Reservation for this ingredient released (delta reduces inventory_reservations_summary)

states.name: SHIPMENT_PLANNED
states.description: Planned-only shipment row; no inventory consumed.
visible_indicators: Ship dialog action available on parent SO detail
invariants: Shipment lines carry stock_allocations(demandType='sales_shipment_line', status='active')
No inventory_events of subtype 'shipped'/'sales_ship' for this shipment

states.name: SHIPMENT_SHIPPED
visible_indicators: Shipment shows shipped timestamp; Ship action no longer available
invariants: stock_allocations(demandType='sales_shipment_line') for this shipment are status='consumed' or 'cancelled'
Inventory ledger has events of subtype 'sales_ship' / 'shipped' for each line
If all parent SO lines closed: parent SO flips to status='done'

states.name: BUCKET_SO_LINE
states.description: stock_allocations row in the 'unplanned residual sales demand' bucket.
visible_indicators: Visible on Sales Allocation tab as sales-line allocation
invariants: UNIQUE (org, demandType, demandId, sourceType, sourceId) WHERE status='active'

states.name: BUCKET_SHIPMENT_LINE
states.description: stock_allocations row in the 'planned shipment demand' bucket.
visible_indicators: Visible against the shipment plan on SO detail
invariants: UNIQUE active row per (org, demandType, demandId, sourceType, sourceId)

states.name: BUCKET_MO_INGREDIENT
states.description: stock_allocations row reserving stock against a released MO's ingredient demand.
visible_indicators: Visible on Sales Allocation tab as production demand
invariants: Released MOs only — drafts and cancelled MOs do not produce active rows

states.name: BUCKET_CONSUMED
states.description: stock_allocations row consumed by a pick or ship event. Terminal except for re-emergence via output reversal.
visible_indicators: Not displayed as active demand; appears in audit history
invariants: UNIQUE-active constraint released so a new active row may be created

states.name: BUCKET_CANCELLED
states.description: stock_allocations row cancelled by shipment delete, MO cancel, or allocation rewrite.
visible_indicators: Not displayed; audit history only
invariants: UNIQUE-active constraint released; replacement row may be inserted

state_coverage_gaps.gap: Concurrent pick of the same ingredient
state_coverage_gaps.description: Two simultaneous POSTs to /pick for the same ingredient. The DAL locks the ingredient row FOR UPDATE (queries.ts 6246-6267) and lockItemsInTx (manufacturing.ts 354) before reading available. Expected behaviour: the second caller observes the ingredient already in INGREDIENT_FULL and gets 400 'is already picked'. Coverage should assert exactly one set of manufacturing_pick_allocations rows is written across both calls and exactly one of the two HTTP responses is 200.

state_coverage_gaps.gap: Cost-basis race between two MOs completing into the same product
state_coverage_gaps.description: MO-A and MO-B both complete and produce into the same product. produceManufacturedStockInTx resolves unitCost from a snapshot at call time. If both txs run concurrently their appendPositiveStockToExistingLotInTx calls weighted-average against the lot. lockItemsInTx serialises on the produced product's item row, so the second caller weights against the FIRST caller's new lot quantity, not the original empty lot. Coverage should assert the final lot quantity equals A+B and the final unitCost matches the cumulative weighted average regardless of completion order.

evidence.reason: Sorts itemIds for deadlock-free FOR UPDATE.

state_coverage_gaps.gap: Concurrent SO line rewrite + shipment plan
state_coverage_gaps.description: An admin rewrites SO lines (which moves allocations via replaceShipmentLinesPreservingAllocationsInTx + cancelShipmentLineAllocationsInTx) while a planner creates a new shipment (pullUnplannedSalesAllocationsToShipmentLineInTx). Both touch stock_allocations on the same demand surface. Coverage should assert: (a) UNIQUE-active constraint never violated, (b) total active allocation quantity does not exceed item availability, (c) final demand reconciliation matches the live SO line quantities. saveManufacturingOutputAllocation racing with /ship is the related MO-side variant — it is NOT Idempotency-Key gated and NOT wrapped in beginInventoryOperationInTx, so this is an open risk noted in the contract.

state_coverage_gaps.gap: reverseManufacturingOutputInTx when produced lot already consumed by a shipment
state_coverage_gaps.description: T_OUTPUT_REVERSE on an MO whose produced lot has already been partly consumed by a downstream shipment. The kernel must consume back from the surviving lot quantity AND walk back the ingredient restocks. If the lot is already exhausted by the shipment, reversal should error out cleanly rather than create negative lot balances. Phase 1 marked BR-12 high confidence but did not open the exact guard for already-consumed-by-ship case.

Operator records output with disposition='blocked'. A downstream shipment line carrying an active 'manufacturing_order' source allocation does NOT get its promise materialised (T_MATERIALISE_MO_PROMISE skipped). T_SHIP_NORMAL then returns 409 wait-for-MO even though a lot for this MO exists. This is an intentional invariant (BR-13/BR-14) — coverage should assert it explicitly.

state_coverage_gaps.gap: MissingCostBasisError on negative ship for product without active BOM
state_coverage_gaps.description: T_SHIP_NEGATIVE_OVERRIDE for a product whose active BOM cost-walk fails (e.g. circular BOM or missing material currentStockUnitCost). resolvePositiveStockUnitCostInTx throws MissingCostBasisError which is NOT translated to SalesError by route handlers, so it surfaces as 500. Coverage should assert this case is detected before allowing the override OR that the 500 surface is acceptable.

state_coverage_gaps.gap: Xero push side-effect asymmetry on idempotency replay
state_coverage_gaps.description: shipSalesShipment runs the Xero push OUTSIDE the inventory tx. An idempotency replay returns the cached body and does NOT re-fire the Xero push. If the first call wrote inventory but Xero push silently failed, a replay will not retry the push. Coverage should assert: (a) initial Xero push failure is recorded on the integration audit events, (b) replay does not double-push, (c) markXeroPushFailed is set when push fails (unless XeroError 'not connected').

Intermediate batches release only their slice via produceManufacturedStockInTx; the final batch + releaseRemainingExpectedOutputInTx zeroes the remainder. If intermediate-batch releases miscount, a residual expected_increase could linger after all batches done. Coverage should assert COUNT of open expected supply contributions for the MO is zero after the final T_BATCH_COMPLETE -> T_PARENT_DONE.

state_coverage_gaps.gap: Discrete /outputs lot weighted-average divergence from variance-adjusted order total
state_coverage_gaps.description: Second /outputs call on a discrete MO appends to the SAME lot via weighted-average using the snapshot ingredient cost at call time. If /complete later supplies ingredientActuals that variance-adjust totals, manufacturing_orders.actualCostPerUnit diverges from the lot's unitCost (which was set from the first call's snapshot). Phase 2 surfaces this divergence as a known gap; the contract risk_areas already calls it out.

Phase 1 critic upgraded BR-12 to high confidence. The state model treats T_OUTPUT_REVERSE as a high-confidence transition for the normal case (lot decrement + variance_gain restock). Edge cases (already-shipped lot, partial reversal of a multi-call discrete output) remain noted in the gaps above. Marked here as COVERED for the canonical reversal flow.
